prompts.purpose:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset: final premium DataTerra pitch-deck slide, landscape exact 1920 x 1080 pixels, exact 16:9.
INPUTS: Image 1 is the source slide/edit target. Image 2 is ONLY the DataTerra brand/style reference. Restyle Image 1; do not copy business-model content from image 2.
Create an elegant, harmonious, perfectly aligned dark editorial slide. Preserve every meaningful English text from target, spelling and semantic content exactly. Absolutely no white background. Palette: background #101b17, panels #182720, thin borders #34463a, ivory text #edf2e8, sage accents #b3cf91, muted #b5c3b0, tiny terracotta #e4a080. Montserrat bold headings, Poppins body. Current DataTerra logo as in image 2 (three sage stacked rounded outline diamonds beside lowercase dataterra, bold data, regular terra, tiny terracotta dot), small at top center. Very subtle topographic contour lines only in far corners, no visual clutter, no glow.
COMPOSITION: balanced 80 px safe margins; centered top header with generous breathing room. Small sage uppercase eyebrow "OUR PURPOSE"; primary heading "Responsible Digital Infrastructure" in large bold ivory, centered. Under it centered text "Unifying territorial data to guide Brazil’s digital future with transparency and security."
Below, three identical-width and equal-height elegant dark-green panels in a single row, symmetric spacing and padding. Each has a small sage line icon at top (layered data/connected nodes; sustainable infrastructure/leaf; location pin with shield), then its heading and readable body. Left-align text inside panels. Each heading starts at same vertical coordinate; each body starts at same vertical coordinate. Make text clearly legible, not tiny. Avoid gratuitous labels or statistics.
CARD 1:
"From Dispersed Data to Strategic Intelligence"
"Converting complex environmental, water, energy, and connectivity layers into immediate pre-feasibility decision support."
CARD 2:
"Sustainable Growth for Brazil’s AI Era"
"Empowering developers, hyperscalers, and government agencies to build the future of infrastructure with high efficiency and socio-environmental responsibility."
CARD 3:
"Beyond Location"
"True Territorial Compatibility"
"Evaluating site feasibility through the lens of water security, grid resilience, and local community impact before capital commitment."
Treat True Territorial Compatibility as smaller sage subheading inside third card. Retain balanced white space and polished typography. No placeholder text, no extra slogans, no fake sources, no page number, no 3D. Output one complete finished PNG slide filling the canvas with exact 16:9 proportions.
prompts.roadmap:
Use case: style-transfer and compositing. Asset: final DataTerra pitch-deck slide, exact landscape 1920 x 1080, exact 16:9.
INPUTS: Image 1 is original roadmap edit target. Image 2 is ONLY DataTerra dark design reference. Image 3 is a real supplied photograph of Scala Data Centers Campus Tamboré; use this actual image as the photo, no invented datacenter.
Restyle target into polished dark DataTerra. Retain complete English text and four milestones, improve centering and clear hierarchy. Palette #101b17 background, #182720 panels, #34463a subtle borders, #edf2e8 ivory text, #b5c3b0 muted text, #b3cf91 sage accents. Montserrat headings, Poppins body. Small current DataTerra logo near upper-left as in reference (three sage stacked outline diamonds, dataterra with orange final dot).
LAYOUT: left content area x=0..1118; right photo area x=1118..1920, full height. The boundary at x1118 must be perfectly vertical, straight, sharp, square, no fade, no feather, no gradient, no rounded corners. The right panel is an aesthetically cropped large real aerial datacenter photograph from Image 3, keeping building recognizable. Dark solid caption strip at bottom of photo with small ivory source text "Campus Tamboré · Barueri, Brazil" and "Photo: Scala Data Centers · scaladatacenters.com/data-centers". No other invented photo caption.
LEFT: inner padding around80px. Header "Product Roadmap" bold ivory with sage small accent line, then readable subtitle:
"Scalable B2B & B2G monetization driven by real-world pilot validation."
Below a clean vertical timeline of FOUR evenly spaced milestones, fully inside 80px bottom margin. Four sage outline circles connected by fine vertical line. Appropriate outline icons INSIDE circles: research/microscope; connected data/grid; clipboard/checkmark; globe. No meaningless diagonal dashed lines spilling off canvas. Milestone text aligned in a single column right of icons, no overlapping.
Exact milestones:
1. "Active MVP & Academic Model Refinement"
"Continuous research with experts in hydraulic, environmental, sustainable computing engineering, and more."
2. "Advanced Data Integration"
"Mapping voltage levels, substation bay capacity, transmission grid, and more."
3. "Extensive Methodological Validation"
"Running pilot projects with more developers, colocation operators, and engineering consultancies."
4. "International Expansion & FDI Bridge"
"Partnering with cross-border innovation hubs to route global FDI into sustainable LATAM digital hubs."
Use clear readable approximately30px bold titles and24px body. Timeline visually spacious but all text must fit; multi-line wraps are okay. No dates or claims that future milestones have already been achieved. Remove all angle-bracket instructions and replace with appropriate photo/icons. One finished PNG slide, exact16:9.
